title: Domino Wonder Dash
one_line: Trace, topple magic dominoes and sing along: ABC, Hindi and Bangla letters, 65 rhymes, numbers, animals, India, road safety and more, Nursery to Class 7, with English, Hindi or Bangla voice.
how_to_play: Tap once to start. Walk through Wonder Town or tap Pictures, pick a picture, trace the dots with your finger or mouse, then tap to topple the dominoes and watch the magic show. Rhymes and letters are then sung with the words lighting up. The red play button shows a real video. The ? button explains everything with moving pictures; Games has Find it!, Spell it, Cross the Road, Draw my own and stories.
description: A free learning game for children from Nursery to Class 7, with 838 pictures in 15 subjects. Every picture has a real dotted outline to trace: A to Z and a to z (each letter shows its word, A for Apple, and has its own sing-along), the Hindi varnamala and the Bangla barnamala (spoken and sung in Hindi and Bengali), 65 sing-along rhymes in English, Hindi and Bengali (traditional rhymes and poems by Tagore, Sukumar Ray and others), numbers, shapes and maths, the India map with all 28 states and 8 union territories, monuments, animals, birds, sea life, plants, food, home, feelings, good habits, helpers, vehicles, the world, science and social studies for Class 6 and 7, and road safety with a Cross the Road game. When the outline is traced, dominoes stand up on it; tap and every cascade becomes a new show with its own raga melody, suspense twists, a wave of light, butterflies or fireflies and a butterfly-effect finale, then the real picture appears and the name is said, spelled and shown, with a What's next? mystery picture. Moving picture guides and a helping hand teach young children how to play without reading. Real-life videos (Wikimedia Commons, checked by hand), Find it!, Spell it, Draw my own, 14 stories, up to six players, a rainbow cap and stickers, and a parents' report. Works offline once loaded. Pictures: OpenMoji (CC BY-SA 4.0) and drawn for the game; maps: Natural Earth.
